answer: The strongest lever is simple: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because ocean only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, ridge is enforced in the ledger: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any garden approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
